homeAffordabilityCalculator.title: 房屋负担能力计算器
homeAffordabilityCalculator.description: 根据收入、债务和财务状况计算您能负担的房价
homeAffordabilityCalculator.monthlyDebtsDesc: 包括学生贷款、车贷、信用卡等
homeAffordabilityCalculator.frontEndRule: 前端比率: 住房成本 ≤ 总收入的28%
homeAffordabilityCalculator.backEndRule: 后端比率: 总债务支出 ≤ 总收入的36%
homeAffordabilityCalculator.guidelinesNote: 这些是指导原则 - 实际批准取决于信用、资产和贷款类型
homeAffordabilityCalculator.fhaNote: FHA贷款可能允许更高比率(后端比率最高43%)
homeAffordabilityCalculator.keyFactors: 影响负担能力的关键因素
homeAffordabilityCalculator.creditScoreFactor: 信用评分: 更高评分获得更好利率
homeAffordabilityCalculator.dtiFactor: 债务收入比: 更低DTI = 更强购买力
homeAffordabilityCalculator.interestRateFactor: 利率: 即使0.5%的差异也很重要
homeAffordabilityCalculator.locationFactor: 地理位置: 房产税和保险因地而异
homeAffordabilityCalculator.estimateNote: 此计算器提供估算 - 实际贷款批准取决于多种因素
homeAffordabilityCalculator.maintenanceNote: 预算维护费用(房屋价值的1-3%/年)
homeAffordabilityCalculator.emergencyFundNote: 保持应急基金与首付款分开
homeAffordabilityCalculator.preApprovalNote: 购房前获得预批准以获得准确数字
homeAffordabilityCalculator.ownershipCostsNote: 考虑所有房屋拥有成本: 水电、维修、升级
